## Instructions

1. Cream butter and sugar; add eggs.
2. Stir in flour, soda, salt and cinnamon.
3. Add oats.
4. Add raisins.
5. Drop on a greased sheet and flatten.
6. Bake at 350°F, 12 to 15 minutes.
